annotations.rationale: Mapping of this cell set to a mature myelinating oligodendrocyte is supported by spatial transcriptomic evidence and specific expression of Klk6 in the context of oligodendrocyte lineage cells.
Mapping of this cell set to a myelin-forming oligodendrocyte is supported by spatial transcriptomic evidence and specific expression of Ctps, Cldn11 in the context of oligodendrocyte lineage cells.

Mapping of this cell set to a newly formed oligodendrocyte is supported by spatial transcriptomic evidence and specific expression of Tcf7l2, Klk6, Cemip2, Casr in the context of oligodendrocyte lineage cells.
Mapping of this cell type is supported by analysis: https://github.com/Cellular-Semantics/cellular_semantics_notebooks

annotations.cell_ontology_term: medial ganglionic eminence derived GABAergic cortical interneuron
caudal ganglionic eminence derived cortical interneuron

annotations.rationale: Mapping of this cell set to a differentiation-committed oligodendrocyte is supported by spatial transcriptomic evidence and specific expression of Gpr17, Bmp4, Neu4, Fyn in the context of oligodendrocyte lineage cells.

annotations.cell_ontology_term: L5 extratelencephalic projecting glutamatergic cortical neuron
internal globus pallidus shell projection neuron
annotations.rationale: Mapped to the general type GPi shell neuron (internal globus pallidus shell projection neuron) based on soma location (to GPi & surrounding GPi core neurons), neurotransmitter (dual GABA-Glut), somastatin expression and MapMyCells heirarchical annotation transfer mapping to Primate GPi core (CS20250428_GROUP_0016) in the Basal Ganglion taxonomy.

annotations.cell_ontology_term: internal globus pallidus core projecting neuron
annotations.rationale: Mapping to the general type GPi core (internal globus pallidus core projecting neuron) is based on location (soma in GPi, nested inside GPi shell neurons), prediced GABA neurotransmitter, Pvalb expression, and MapMyCells hierarchical annotation transfer mapping to primate GPi core (CS20250428_GROUP_0015).
Mapping of this cell type is supported by analysis: https://github.com/Cellular-Semantics/cellular_semantics_notebooks
Mapping to tanycyte of subfornical organ based on spatial transcriptomics evidence.

Consistent with this cell set being composed of Pinealocytes, a combination of Pinealocyte markers Gngt1 and Crx can identify the cells in this cluster with a confidence (F-beta score) of 0.91 in the context of glutamatergic cells (Pinealocytes release glutamate) from the hippocampal formation dissection (which includes the pineal gland).

Mapping of this cell set to the hypendemal cell type is supported by its location to the subcommisural organ (from spatial transcriptomics), its expression of Sspo and its general transcriptomic classification in a class (Astro-Epen) along with epdendymal cells, tanycytes and astrocytes.

labelsets.name: neurotransmitter
labelsets.description: Clusters are assigned based on the average expression of both neurotransmitter transporter genes and key neurotransmitter synthesizing enzyme genes.

labelsets.name: class
labelsets.description: The top level of cell type definition in the mouse whole brain taxonomy. It is primarily determined by broad brain region and neurotransmitter type. All cells within a subclass belong to the same class. Class provides a broader categorization of cell types.

labelsets.name: subclass
labelsets.description: The coarse level of cell type definition in the mouse whole brain taxonomy. All cells within a supertype belong to the same subclass. Subclass groups together related supertypes.

labelsets.name: supertype
labelsets.description: The second finest level of cell type definition in the mouse whole brain taxonomy. All cells within a cluster belong to the same supertype. Supertype groups together similar clusters.

labelsets.name: cluster
labelsets.description: The finest level of cell type definition in the mouse whole brain taxonomy. Cells within a cluster share similar characteristics and belong to the same supertype.
